E-BOOT-001.title: Limine Bootloader Config Missing
E-BOOT-001.cause: The boot configuration /boot/limine.conf could not be found or is corrupted.
E-BOOT-001.fix: Boot into live recovery media, chroot via grintion-chroot, and run 'grintion-boot fix'.

E-BOOT-002.title: TPM PCR Measurement Mismatch
E-BOOT-002.cause: PCR 0 or 7 deviated from the baseline snapshot, preventing automatic LUKS unsealing.
E-BOOT-002.fix: Enter manual recovery passphrase, inspect firmware changes, and run 'grintion-attest snapshot' to accept new measurements.

E-PKG-001.title: Garb Lockfile Stale
E-PKG-001.cause: A previous package operation was interrupted, leaving /var/lib/garb/lock active.
E-PKG-001.fix: Run 'grintion-doctor --fix' or verify no garb processes are running and remove /var/lib/garb/lock.

E-PKG-002.title: Package Signature Verification Failed
E-PKG-002.cause: Downloaded package archive checksum or signature does not match repository index.
E-PKG-002.fix: Verify network connection, refresh repository metadata with 'garb sync', and check signing keys in /etc/garb/keys.

E-NET-001.title: No Network Carrier Detected
E-NET-001.cause: Ethernet cable unplugged or Wi-Fi radio powered off.
E-NET-001.fix: Check physical connection or toggle Wi-Fi radio on with 'grintion-network reconnect'.

E-NET-002.title: DNS Leak Detected
E-NET-002.cause: DNS queries are resolving to non-encrypted or unapproved public upstream resolvers.
E-NET-002.fix: Run 'grintion-network dns-leak-test' and enforce secure DNS profile via 'grintion-config'.

E-SEC-001.title: File Integrity Tampering Detected
E-SEC-001.cause: One or more critical system binaries differed from the cryptographic baseline.
E-SEC-001.fix: Run 'grintion-integrity check' to identify modified paths, inspect audit logs, and restore official binaries via 'garb reinstall'.

E-SEC-002.title: USB Storage Device Blocked
E-SEC-002.cause: USB data-block mode or USBGuard policy prevented mounting untrusted mass storage.
E-SEC-002.fix: Authorize device explicitly with 'grintion-usb authorize <DEV>' or switch mode with 'grintion-usb allow-data'.

E-FS-001.title: Filesystem Dirty or Mount Incomplete
E-FS-001.cause: Unclean shutdown caused journal replay or dangling mount state.
E-FS-001.fix: Run fsck or snapshot rollback via 'grintion-snapshot rollback <ID>'.
